newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils crude pipeline shut, berthing suspended.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils crude pipeline shut, berthing suspended.

text.p: The crude pipeline feeding the Baltic port of Ventspils was shut late on Wednesday and remained closed on Thursday morning, shipping sources said.
The pipeline, which carries Russian Urals crude, was closed as storage tanks reached full capacity, the sources said.
"The problem arose because the Hellespont Hope, which arrived at the port at 2130 (local time), was unable to berth due to bad weather and the tanks filled up," a source said.
The Hellespont Hope was due to take on 73,000 tonnes of Urals crude. Another crude tanker, the Fosna, was also at anchor outside the port waiting to load a similar quantity.
"They'll want to get them on (a berth) as soon as possible but the weather forecast for today is not good," said the source.
Strong winds were preventing berthing and there was little prospect of an immediate improvement in weather conditions.
Deliveries of oil products to the Latvian port were not affected by the closure of the crude pipeline.
Meanwhile, the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk, Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally on Thursday, shipping sources said.
